Bangladesh: Killing of Local Political Activist Raises Serious Human Rights Concerns The killing of a local political activist in Jashore has renewed concerns about political violence, impunity, and the protection of fundamental human rights in Bangladesh. Jewel Rana, a member of the Patibila Union Youth League, died on 11 June after being severely injured in an attack in Chowgacha Upazila, according to police and hospital officials. Family members have accused local activists associated with the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) of carrying out the assault, while police say preliminary investigations suggest the incident stemmed from a political dispute. Regardless of political affiliation, the right to life is a fundamental human right protected under both Bangladesh’s Constitution and international human rights law. The brutal nature of the attack, as described by witnesses and relatives, underscores the urgent need for a thorough, impartial, and transparent investigation. Human rights principles require that allegations of politically motivated violence be investigated without bias and that all suspects be afforded due process under the law. At the same time, victims and their families are entitled to justice, truth, and effective remedies. The incident has also drawn attention to broader concerns about retaliatory violence following political transitions. Human rights advocates have repeatedly warned that cycles of revenge, intimidation, and politically motivated attacks undermine the rule of law and contribute to a climate of fear within communities. Particularly troubling are allegations made by the victim’s family regarding the treatment of Jewel Rana during the attack. Family members claim he was denied assistance while seriously injured and that his wife was assaulted while attempting to protect him. These allegations have not been independently verified, but if substantiated, they would represent grave violations of human dignity and basic humanitarian standards. The case highlights the importance of ensuring equal protection under the law for all citizens, irrespective of their political beliefs or affiliations. Human rights organizations have long maintained that political differences must never be settled through violence. Authorities have stated that several individuals have been questioned and that efforts are ongoing to arrest those responsible. Human rights observers will likely monitor whether the investigation is conducted independently and whether those found responsible are held accountable through legal processes. As Bangladesh continues to navigate political tensions, this case serves as a reminder that justice, accountability, and respect for human rights remain essential to preventing further violence and protecting democratic values. The protection of life, security, and political freedoms must apply equally to every citizen, regardless of party affiliation. #Bangladesh

A fortnight ago, Vijay Gokhale observed that China sees Indian democracy as a long-term ideological problem. The Chinese commentary that followed went to lengths explaining why India does not matter, why Indian democracy is a curse, and why Indian aspirations exceed Indian means. That vehemence is a tell in itself. Indifference does not produce it. That India even manages to function at this scale, with this civilisational depth, absorbing its contradictions with a democratic polity, worries Beijing far more than it is willing to admit. Even after decades of neutralising democratic experiments in China's near abroad (read Hong Kong), the CCP has no template to explain India to its own citizens. «دادگاه دائمی مردمی» مستقر در رم، تصمیم اتحادیه اروپا برای دعوت از یک هیأت فنی طالبان به بروکسل برای گفت‌وگو در مورد اخراج مهاجران به افغانستان را محکوم کرده و خواستار لغو آن شده است. این دادگاه امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۲۱ جوزا) با نشر اعلامیه‌ای گفته است که «تصمیم اتحادیه اروپا گامی خطرناک در جهت عادی‌سازی روابط با رژیمی است که مسئول آپارتاید جنسیتی، نقض‌ سیستماتیک و نهادینه‌شده‌ی حقوق‌بشر، و نابودی تمامی آزادی‌های اساسی زنان افغانستان است.» «دادگاه دائمی مردمی» افزوده است، اگرچه اتحادیه اروپا طالبان ذا به عنوان «دولت بالفعل و مشروع» به رسمیت نمی‌شناسد، اما این تصمیم با اصول اعلام‌شده‌‌ی حقوق‌بشری اتحادیه اروپا در تضاد است و به حمایت از رژیم‌های توتالیتر در زمانی‌که با منافع اتحادیه اروپا همسو باشند، کمک می‌کند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/255284

A horrific stabbing incident in #Belfast this week showed something every investigator, journalist, analyst, and security professional should understand: Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) is no longer optional. Starting with a single BBC News article and a few basic Google searches, I was able to move quickly into ShadowDragon Horizon and begin mapping the publicly available online footprint connected to the suspect arrested in this case. In under 25 minutes, the picture started to form: Public social media presence. Profiles and connections. Posts, comments, and visible relationships. People online claiming to know him or be connected to him. Signals that help investigators understand context, networks, and possible relevance. That is the power of #OSINT. Not hacking. Not guessing. Not “doxxing.” Just disciplined collection, verification, and analysis of publicly available information. Cases like this are also a reminder of how fast information (and misinformation) moves after a violent incident. Within hours, narratives form. Anger spreads. Online claims become fuel. Communities can be put at risk. That is why responsible OSINT matters. Tools like ShadowDragon Horizon do not replace judgment, tradecraft, or ethics. They amplify them. They help investigators move from scattered fragments to structured intelligence: entities, links, timelines, networks, and context. The lesson is not simply that “you can find someone online.” The lesson is that, when used responsibly, OSINT can help us understand the wider information environment around a serious incident before speculation takes over. In modern investigations, the first crime scene is often physical. The second one is online. We must keep in mind two attitudes in our Christian life in order to be “wise architects” in building the civilization of love. The first guiding principle is to take up the cross of Christ as Good Samaritans, accompanying and helping to carry the burdens of so many brothers and sisters who are crucified by life’s trials. The second principle is to cultivate a Eucharistic spirituality, a spirituality of ecclesial unity in love.

While there is a right to seek refuge when life is threatened, there is also the right not to have to migrate: the right to remain in one’s own home without hunger, war, persecution, violence, the land becoming uninhabitable, corruption stealing the bread from the poor, or weapons destroying the future of children. #ApostolicJourney

Every boat that arrives brings a question along with the migrants: what kind of world have we built, if so many brothers and sisters must risk death to seek life? Human dignity demands legal and safe pathways, rescue and assistance, real cooperation against traffickers, effective protection for victims, serious processes of reception and integration, and policies that allow every person to live with dignity in their own land. We cannot grow accustomed to counting the dead. Human dignity has no passport and does not lose its value when crossing a border. #ApostolicJourney

Do the rule of law, press freedom, freedom of expression, democracy, and even the truth still matter? Or is what truly matters simply who is connected to whom? Consider the #UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) fact-finding report on the July–August 2024 unrest in Bangladesh. The report stated that approximately 1,400 people were killed during the violence. Media outlets around the world widely cited this figure, yet few appeared to question how the OHCHR arrived at that number. To date, the @UNHumanRights has not publicly provided a complete list of names or identities corresponding to the reported fatalities. Meanwhile, both the Yunus administration and the subsequent Tarique government have reportedly identified around 834 victims so far, despite nearly two years having passed since the events. This raises an obvious question: who are the remaining individuals included in the OHCHR’s reported total? What is even more troubling is that when a UN representative was asked whether she had personally reviewed the underlying evidence supporting the report’s conclusions, she responded that because the findings came from another UN department—essentially their colleagues—they accepted the figures on that basis. Such an approach, if accurately characterized, would represent a serious failure of scrutiny and accountability. If the 1,400-death figure has indeed been shown to be inaccurate, then the credibility of the report and the institutions involved must be subjected to rigorous examination. The pursuit of truth should require evidence, transparency, and verification—not unquestioning acceptance based on institutional relationships. For many observers, this raises concerns about whether some officials within the OHCHR, particularly under the office of @volker_turk, contributed to the spread of a narrative that may not withstand factual scrutiny. These questions deserve clear answers. Accountability, transparency, and truth should apply equally to international organizations, governments, and all institutions that claim to defend human rights and democratic values. Of the 834 individuals whose identities have reportedly been established, a genuinely impartial investigation into each case could have helped determine the actual circumstances and causes of death. This raises an important question: why has there not been an independent investigation into even a single case over the past two years? Some may wonder whether a thorough and transparent inquiry would reveal facts that challenge prevailing narratives about the events of July. If the true causes of these deaths were established through credible investigations, it could provide a clearer understanding of what actually occurred and allow competing claims to be evaluated against evidence rather than speculation and the established narrative. The absence of such investigations fuels concerns that important facts remain undisclosed. A proper examination of the evidence could either validate or undermine the claims made by those who continue to invoke the legacy of “July,” and that only an independent, fact-based process can resolve these questions and bring greater clarity to the public. That’s why I sometimes wonder whether the truth really matters, or whether everything is ultimately about controlling the narrative, regardless of how much it is based on falsehoods. -Mohammad Ali Arafat Video

आज हम एक ऐतिहासिक पल के साक्षी बन रहे हैं। आज भारत के लोकतांत्रिक इतिहास में एक ऐतिहासिक अध्याय जुड़ा है। हमारे प्रिय नेता प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी ने 62 वर्षों पुराना रिकॉर्ड तोड़ते हुए देश के सबसे लंबे समय तक सेवा देने वाले निर्वाचित प्रधानमंत्री बनने का गौरव प्राप्त किया है। बिना थके, बिना रुके और बिना कोई दाग के मोदी जी का कार्यकाल बहुत ही प्रशंसनीय है। उनकी स्थिरता, निरंतरता और निर्णायक नेतृत्व भारतीय इतिहास का स्वर्णिम कालखंड है। मोदी जी ने गुरु नानक देव जी के "सत्ता को सेवा" तथा "संविधान को प्रशासन का धर्मग्रंथ" मानने के आदर्शों और गुरु रामदास जी के निष्काम कर्मयोगी के संदेश को "प्रधानसेवक" बनकर चरितार्थ करने का काम किया है। उन्होंने 'उपभोग शून्य स्वामी' की कल्पना को चरितार्थ करके हमेशा राष्ट्र प्रथम के भाव को आगे बढ़ाया है। प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी के 12 वर्षों में देश के अनेक भूले-बिसरे स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों और राष्ट्रीय नायकों को सम्मान मिला। उन्होंने दशकों पुरानी नक्सलवाद, आतंकवाद और धारा 370 आदि की समस्या को 12 वर्षों में समाप्त किया। आज भारत, दुनिया की पांचवीं सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था बन गया है और विकास के हर क्षेत्र में तेजी से आगे बढ़ रहा है। चाहे महिला सशक्तिकरण की बात हो, किसानों या युवाओं की सशक्तिकरण की बात हो... हर वर्ग का विकास हुआ है। आज कोई भी क्षेत्र विकास से अछूता नहीं है। यही नहीं, मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में भारत आज crisis management का वैश्विक मॉडल बनकर उभरा है, जिसका विश्वभर में शोध हो रहा है। मोदी जी का एक साधारण परिवार से निकलकर 25 वर्षों तक लगातार जनता का विश्वास प्राप्त करना... भारतीय लोकतंत्र की सबसे बड़ी ताकत का प्रमाण है। यह केवल एक रिकॉर्ड नहीं, बल्कि 140 करोड़ देशवासियों के विश्वास, संकल्प और आकांक्षाओं की विजय है। - श्री @AmitShah, केन्द्रीय गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री Video

नीती आयोगाच्या बैठकीत महाराष्ट्राच्या प्रगतीचा रोड मॅप सादर पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली राष्ट्रपती भवन, नवी दिल्ली येथे आयोजित ‘नीती आयोगाच्या गव्हर्निंग कौन्सिल’च्या 11व्या बैठकीत मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस सहभागी झाले. यावेळी त्यांनी विकसित महाराष्ट्राच्या संकल्पनेला बळ देणारा सर्वसमावेशक विकासाचा रोडमॅप सादर केला. ‘विकसित भारत 2047’ या संकल्पनेच्या पूर्ततेसाठी शिक्षण, आरोग्य, कौशल्य विकास, महिला सक्षमीकरण आणि सर्वसमावेशक मानवी विकास या पाच प्रमुख क्षेत्रांवर राज्य शासन विशेष भर देत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. 'विकसित महाराष्ट्र-2047' अंतर्गत 2030 पर्यंत $1 ट्रिलियन, 2035 पर्यंत $2 ट्रिलियन आणि 2047 पर्यंत $5 ट्रिलियन अर्थव्यवस्था उभी करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्रात राष्ट्रीय शैक्षणिक धोरण 2020 (NEP) ची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी, एआय, रोबोटिक्स, डेटा सायन्स आणि ब्लॉकचेनसारख्या आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा शिक्षणात समावेश, नवी मुंबई येथे जागतिक दर्जाची ‘एज्युसिटी’, तसेच कौशल्य विकास, स्टार्टअप्स आणि उद्योजकतेला प्रोत्साहन देणारी धोरणे राबविण्यात येत आहेत. तसेच, आरोग्य क्षेत्रात आयुष्मान भारत आणि महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जनआरोग्य योजनेचा विस्तार, नवीन वैद्यकीय महाविद्यालये आणि मेडिसिटीसारख्या संकल्पना राबविण्यात येत आहेत. महिला सक्षमीकरणासाठी ‘उमेद’ अभियान आणि मुख्यमंत्री माझी लाडकी बहीण योजना राबविली जात आहे. कृषी, उद्योग, पर्यटन, डिजिटल प्रशासन आणि एआयसारख्या क्षेत्रातील उपक्रमांमुळे राज्याच्या प्रगतीला नवी गती मिळत आहे, तसेच महाराष्ट्र देशाच्या विकासात अग्रणी भूमिका बजावत राहील, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @NITIAayog #ViksitBharat2047 #GoverningCouncil #ViksitMaharashtra2047 #DevendraFadnavis

Professional surfer Matt Wilkinson had a close encounter with a shark while surfing near Ballina, New South Wales, on Wednesday, October 7. A Surf Life Saving NSW drone alerted Wilkinson with a recorded message as the shark circled near him off Sharpes Beach. “I was surfing out the back at Sharpes Beach and just cruising on my own and I heard a splash and a noise and looked around and couldn’t see anything,” said Wilkinson. “Then the drone came down and told me that there was a dangerous shark in the area, return to the beach. “I got to the shore feeling a bit weird and the lifeguards showed me the footage and I realised how close it came without knowing it was there. It looks like it’s going for my leg and it’s changed its mind,” he added. The beach was closed after the incident. Drone operator Beau Monks said he’d just launched his seventh drone flight of the day when he spotted the shark near Wilkinson. “It sort of came out of nowhere, then went right up to Matt. It moved pretty fast. I was tracking it and notified the lifeguards and used the speaker on the drone to get everyone out of the water. Within 10 seconds it was at the surfer and five seconds later it was gone,” said Beau Monks. Surf Life Saving NSW operates drones at 34 beaches across New South Wales. Video

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, this afternoon met with H.E. Christopher Landau, the United States’ Deputy Secretary of State, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Both sides discussed ways to further advance the ASEAN-United States Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP), including initiatives to commemorate the 50th anniversary of ASEAN-US Dialogue Relations and the 5th anniversary of the ASEAN-US Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) in 2027. They also exchanged views on regional and global developments, as well as other topics of mutual interest.

ASEAN and the EU reviewed the progress of cooperation and exchanged views on potential areas of future cooperation during the 33rd Meeting of the ASEAN-EU Joint Cooperation Committee, held today at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting was co-chaired by the Permanent Representative of Brunei Darussalam to ASEAN, H.E. Latifah Zaini, and the Head of Southeast Asia and ASEAN Division at the European External Action Service, Ms. Leila Fernández-Stembridge, together with the Acting Head of Unit for South and South-East Asia at the European Commission Directorate-General for International Partnerships, Mr. Ian Hoskins. Permanent Representatives of ASEAN Member States or their representatives and the staff of the ASEAN Secretariat attended the meeting.

The Ambassador of the United States of America to ASEAN, H.E. Kevin Kim, today presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Kim on the commencement of his tenure and reaffirmed the importance of the ASEAN-United States (U.S.) Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in advancing peace, stability, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region. He highlighted the U.S.’s longstanding engagement with ASEAN and appreciated its unwavering support for ASEAN Centrality and ASEAN Community-building efforts, regional economic integration, digital transformation, and development initiatives. Secretary-General Dr. Kao underscored the significance of ASEAN-led mechanisms, including the East Asia Summit (EAS), ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), and the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), in fostering dialogue, mutual trust, and cooperation on regional and global issues of common concern. He highlighted that the U.S. has been a steadfast partner and actively participated in these mechanisms. Ambassador Kim reaffirmed the United States’ support for ASEAN centrality and expressed readiness to deepen cooperation in support of the ASEAN-United States Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America adopted in 2025. Ambassador Kim noted the United States is a proud Pacific nation and highlighted opportunities for expanded partnership to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific that benefits our combined one billion people. He also welcomed the upcoming 50th anniversary of ASEAN-U.S. Dialogue Relations in 2027. The U.S. became a Dialogue Partner of ASEAN in 1977 and established a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with ASEAN in 2022. Reflecting its longstanding commitment to ASEAN, the U.S. appointed its first Ambassador to ASEAN in 2008 and established its dedicated Mission to ASEAN in Jakarta, Indonesia, in June 2010. Ambassador Kim is the fifth U.S. Ambassador to ASEAN to date.

📍Sofia -- An excellent opportunity for an engaging and forward-looking fireside chat at the @ECFR event on “EU Enlargement and the Western Balkans”, hosted by Vessela Tcherneva and the Embassy of Albania in Bulgaria. 🇦🇱🇧🇬 Our discussion focused on the renewed momentum behind EU #enlargement and the place of the Western Balkans in an increasingly complex and rapidly evolving geopolitical environment. I was pleased to share #Albania’s perspective on the opportunities and responsibilities that come with this new phase of the enlargement process, as well as the significant progress our country has made on its path towards #EU membership. In today’s strategic context, enlargement is no longer viewed solely as a policy of transformation. It has become a strategic investment in Europe’s security, stability, competitiveness, and long-term resilience. The lessons of recent years have made it clear that a stronger, more united, and geopolitically capable Europe cannot be fully achieved without the integration of the #WesternBalkans into the EU. I emphasized that Albania’s EU accession process, now entering its most decisive and consequential phase, is far more than a foreign policy objective. It is a national aspiration that enjoys broad and enduring support across the political spectrum and throughout Albanian society. Driven by an ambitious reform agenda and a strong commitment to delivering tangible results, our European journey reflects not only institutional transformation but also a clear national and societal choice about the future we want to build. I also underlined that a credible, merit-based enlargement process is in the interest of both candidate countries and the EU itself. #Albania remains fully focused on and committed to maintaining the current momentum, accelerating reforms, and advancing decisively through the negotiation process. Our objective is ambitious but realistic: to conclude accession negotiations by 2027 and achieve full membership by 2030. My sincere thanks to ECFR, @vtcherneva, and all participants for a thoughtful and stimulating exchange. #Horizon2030 -- Një mundësi e shkëlqyer për një bisedë permbjatësore në aktivitetin e @ECFR mbi “Zgjerimin e BE-së dhe Ballkanin Perëndimor”, organizuar nga Vessela Tcherneva dhe Ambasada e Shqipërisë në Bullgari. 🇦🇱🇧🇬 Diskutimi u përqendrua tek rëndësia që ka marrë procesi i #zgjerimit të BE-së dhe te vendi që zë Ballkani Perëndimor në një mjedis gjeopolitik gjithnjë e më kompleks dhe në ndryshim të shpejtë. Pata kënaqësinë të ndaj perspektivën e #Shqipërisë mbi mundësitë dhe përgjegjësitë që sjell kjo fazë e re e procesit të zgjerimit, si edhe mbi progresin domethënës që vendi ynë ka arritur në rrugën drejt anëtarësimit në #BE. Në kontekstin e sotëm strategjik, zgjerimi nuk shihet më vetëm si një politikë transformimi. Ai është shndërruar në një investim strategjik për sigurinë, stabilitetin, konkurrueshmërinë dhe qëndrueshmërinë afatgjatë të BE-së. Zhvillimet e viteve të fundit e kanë bërë të qartë se një Evropë më e fortë, më e bashkuar dhe më e aftë për t’u përballur me sfidat gjeopolitike nuk mund të realizohet plotësisht pa integrimin e #BallkanitPerëndimor në Bashkimin Europian. Theksova se procesi i anëtarësimit të Shqipërisë në BE, i cili po hyn në fazën e tij më vendimtare dhe më përcaktuese, është shumë më tepër sesa një objektiv i politikës së jashtme. Ai është një aspiratë kombëtare që gëzon mbështetje të gjerë dhe të qëndrueshme në të gjithë spektrin politik dhe në mbarë shoqërinë shqiptare. I udhëhequr nga një axhendë ambicioze reformash dhe nga një angazhim i palëkundur për të prodhuar rezultate konkrete, rrugëtimi ynë europian pasqyron jo vetëm transformimin e institucioneve, por edhe një zgjedhje të qartë kombëtare dhe shoqërore për të ardhmen që duam të ndërtojmë. Po ashtu, nënvizova se një proces zgjerimi i besueshëm dhe i bazuar në meritë është në interes si të vendeve kandidate, ashtu edhe të vetë Bashkimit Evropian. #Shqipëria mbetet plotësisht e angazhuar për të ruajtur rritmin aktual, për të përshpejtuar reformat dhe për të avancuar me vendosmëri në procesin e negociatave. Objektivi ynë është ambicioz, por realist: përmbyllja e negociatave të anëtarësimit deri në vitin 2027 dhe anëtarësimi i plotë në Bashkimin Evropianropian deri në vitin 2030. Mirënjohje të sinqertë për ECFR, @vtcherneva dhe të gjithë pjesëmarrësve për këtë shkëmbim mendimesh të vlefshëm dhe frymëzues. #Shqipëria2030

খাগড়াছড়ি জেলার মহালছড়িতে সেনাবাহিনীর ব্যবস্থাপনায় বিনামূল্যে চক্ষু চিকিৎসা প্রদান ও ছানি অপারেশন ঢাকা, ১১ জুন ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): গত ০৭ মে ২০২৬ তারিখে পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর খাগড়াছড়ি রিজিয়নের অন্তর্গত মহালছড়ি জোনের সার্বিক ব্যবস্থাপনায় এবং লায়ন্স হাসপাতালের রোটারী ক্লাবের সহায়তায় একটি বিনামূল্যে চক্ষু চিকিৎসা ক্যাম্পেইন পরিচালিত হয়। উক্ত ক্যাম্পেইনে বিশেষজ্ঞ চিকিৎসকদের মাধ্যমে পাঁচ শতাধিক চক্ষু রোগীর মাঝে চিকিৎসা সেবা সহ বিনামূল্যে ওষুধ বিতরণ এবং প্রথম ধাপে ১৬০ জনকে চশমা প্রদান করা হয়। একই সাথে চোখের বিভিন্ন জটিলতায় আক্রান্ত রোগীদের ছানি (Cataract) অপারেশনের জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয় । এরই ধারাবাহিকতায়, ক্যাম্পেইনের দ্বিতীয় ধাপে উন্নত চিকিৎসা এবং ছানি অপারেশনের জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত রোগীদের গত ০৮ জুন ২০২৬ তারিখে মহালছড়ি জোনের ব্যবস্থাপনায় ৮৪ জন রোগী চট্টগ্রামের লায়ন্স চক্ষু হাসপাতালে প্রেরণ করা হয়। ৮৪ জন রোগীর এই দলটিতে নারীপুরুষ মিলিয়ে ৪৪ জন বাঙালি এবং ৪০ জন পাহাড়ি ব্যক্তি চিকিৎসাসেবা গ্রহন করেন। এই পর্যন্ত ৫৪ জন রোগীর চোখের ছানি অপারেশন সফলভাবে সম্পন্ন করা হয়েছে। উল্লেখ্য, অপারেশন-পরবর্তী সময়ে রোগীদের চিকিৎসা, নিরাপত্তা, উন্নত আবাসন ও খাবারসহ সকল প্রকার প্রয়োজনীয় সহায়তা নিশ্চিত করতে সেনাসদস্যরা নিরলস দায়িত্ব পালন করেন এবং চিকিৎসা শেষে গত ০৮ জুন ২০২৬ তারিখে রোগীদের নিরাপদে নিজ নিজ এলাকায় পৌঁছে দেন। পাহাড়ি ও বাঙালি জনগোষ্ঠীর মাঝে পারস্পরিক সম্প্রীতি বজায় রাখা এবং সাধারণ মানুষের পাশে দাঁড়িয়ে তাদের জীবনযাত্রার মানোন্নয়নে সেনাবাহিনীর এমন জনকল্যাণমূলক ও মানবিক কার্যক্রম ভবিষ্যতেও অব্যাহত থাকবে। Video

India has 3.7 million dog bites a year. It accounts for 36% of global rabies deaths. In May 2026, the Supreme Court ruled that civic authorities may euthanise rabid or demonstrably aggressive stray dogs, calling the right to walk public spaces without fear a fundamental right under Article 21. Is this a landmark ruling or a shortcut that papers over 65 years of governance failure? Malathi Renati (@MalathiRenati) speaks with Samyukta Hornad (@samyuktahornad), founder of Praana Animal Foundation, a popular Kannada actor and someone who has been doing the unglamorous work of animal welfare since the age of 16. This debate is examined through the Samaaj, Sarkaar, and Bazaar: One number worth sitting with: Lucknow sterilised 84% of its stray population, halved birth rates, and was cited by the SC as India's national benchmark. It worked with sustained funding, NGO partnership, and 15,000 trained citizen volunteers. Can other states take courage? We are delighted to announce the launch of Getting Agricultural Markets Right, co-edited by Dr. Ashok Gulati, Dr. Raya Das, and Dr. Tirthankar Patnaik, held at the India Habitat Centre, New Delhi. The event convened a distinguished gathering of policymakers, academics, industry professionals, FPO leaders, and market experts to deliberate on one of the most consequential challenges confronting Indian agriculture today: How can India reform its agricultural marketing system to ensure fair price discovery, effective risk management, and higher farmer incomes? We were honoured by the presence of Dr. Ashok Lahiri (Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog) and Dr. S. Mahendra Dev (Chairman, Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister) as Chief Guests, with special remarks by Dr. Ramesh Chand. Discussions led by Dr. Ashok Gulati, alongside eminent panelists from government, academia, agri-business, commodity exchanges, FPOs, and digital agriculture, made for a rich and substantive dialogue. Among the central themes explored: 🌾 Crop-specificity and regional dimension of procurement 📈 Price risk management and the role of agri-derivatives 🤝 FPO strengthening and value-chain integration 💻 Digital infrastructure, AgriStack, AI, and supply chain traceability 🚜 Technology-driven solutions and market accessibility 🌍 Positioning Indian agriculture within competitive global value chains Rooted in empirical evidence across seven commodity markets, the book examines market structures, price dynamics, MSP frameworks, futures markets, digital platforms, and emerging technologies — charting a credible course toward a more competitive and farmer-centric agricultural economy in India. Deep appreciation to the distinguished speakers, attendees, and the dedicated teams at ICRIER and @NSEIndia who made this convening possible. Full report: icrier.org/publications/gett…

The IAEA has been informed that, for the 19th time since the beginning of the military conflict, the Zaporizhzhya NPP lost all off-site power at around 21:00 local time last night following an attack on an electrical substation on the other side of the Dnipro River. This latest loss of the Ferosplavna‑1 330 kV back up line comes as the plant prepares repairs on the 750 kV Dniprovska main power line — disconnected since 24 March — under the sixth localized ceasefire agreed with both sides to help restore a second off-site power connection. Operating with only one remaining power line leaves the plant extremely vulnerable to conflict-related grid disruptions as we experience it again today. The ZNPP is currently relying on emergency diesel generators to power the cooling of its six shut-down reactors and maintain other essential nuclear safety functions. The latest loss of off-site power once again highlights the extreme fragility of the electrical grid and the constant dangers to nuclear safety during the war, DG @rafaelmgrossi said, reiterating the urgent need for military restraint to prevent a nuclear accident.

The Ambassador of the United States of America to ASEAN, H.E. Yeouk Kim, today presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Kim on the commencement of his tenure and reaffirmed the importance of the ASEAN-United States (U.S.) Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in advancing peace, stability, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region. He highlighted the U.S.’s longstanding engagement with ASEAN and appreciated its unwavering support for ASEAN Centrality and ASEAN Community-building efforts, regional economic integration, digital transformation, and development initiatives. Secretary-General Dr. Kao underscored the significance of ASEAN-led mechanisms, including the East Asia Summit (EAS), ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF), and the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), in fostering dialogue, mutual trust, and cooperation on regional and global issues of common concern. He highlighted that the U.S. has been a steadfast partner and actively participated in these mechanisms. Ambassador Kim reaffirmed the United States’ support for ASEAN centrality and expressed readiness to deepen cooperation in support of the ASEAN-United States Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America adopted in 2025. Ambassador Kim noted the United States is a proud Pacific nation and highlighted opportunities for expanded partnership to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific that benefits our combined one billion people. He also welcomed the upcoming 50th anniversary of ASEAN-U.S. Dialogue Relations in 2027. The U.S. became a Dialogue Partner of ASEAN in 1977 and established a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with ASEAN in 2022. Reflecting its longstanding commitment to ASEAN, the U.S. established its dedicated Mission to ASEAN in Jakarta, Indonesia, in June 2010, and appointed its first dedicated Ambassador to ASEAN in 2011. Ambassador Kim is the fourth dedicated U.S. Ambassador to ASEAN to date.

Asked about U.S. government data showing consumer inflation increased at its fastest pace in three years in May, and whether it could hobble his ​fellow Republicans just months ahead of November's midterm election, Trump said: "I love the inflation." The president then explained ​how he greenlit a plan to secretly move oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz over ⁠concerns of higher costs and increasing inflation. "It was worth it to me," Trump said about his calculus and calling ​the operation a success. "When it's over, you will see oil drop to where it was before," Trump said of ​the larger war. "It's coming down. It's going to come down like a rock." Trump has called the war on Iran a detour and framed it as a national security issue as Tehran's closure of the key shipping route has pushed up the cost of gasoline, fertilizer ​and other goods, contributing to inflation. U.S. President Donald Trump speaks in the Oval Office as he signs the Secure America Act, at the White House in Washington, D.C., U.S., June 10, 2026. REUTERS/Evan Vucci Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab Higher prices could also keep the U.S. Federal Reserve from cutting interest rates, which ​could lower borrowing costs, which Trump has called for since returning to power last year. Republicans are seeking to maintain control of ‌the U.S. ⁠House of Representatives and the Senate but are concerned a consumer backlash could hand the reins to Democrats as the cost of living remains a top issue for voters. Trump himself won the 2024 presidential election in large part because of his promise to lower inflation, but has since seen his approval rating, including on his handling of the cost of living, ​fall to the lowest level ​of his political career. Efforts to ⁠reopen the Strait of Hormuz to tanker traffic to move goods have so far stalled, with industry executives and analysts warning that coming weeks could see another oil price shock ​severe enough to shake the broader financial markets. Even if Trump and Tehran reach a ​deal soon, ⁠it is expected to take months to get supplies moving, with the disruptions expected through 2026. And while Americans may be more insulated from fuel shocks than other nations, ongoing higher energy prices could dent consumer spending over time. Last month, Trump said ⁠Americans' financial ​struggles were not a factor as he pushes for a deal ​even while threatening renewed attacks on Iran: "I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody. I think about one thing: We ​cannot let Iran have a nuclear weapon." - REUTERS #SamaaTV

The FBI and Justice Department just seized 13 fake consulting websites used by Chinese intelligence agents to recruit and bribe U.S. military and government personnel holding active security clearances. Operating since November 2023, the digital dragnet used AI-generated personas and lucrative crypto payouts on mainstream networking platforms like LinkedIn and Upwork to successfully ensnare at least seven targets for insider defense secrets. These overseas operators went to extreme lengths to manufacture an illusion of corporate legitimacy to prey on defense professionals. Posing as legitimate international firms under names like Centrik Global Consulting, GeoIndopacific, and Pulse Wave Global, the suspected spies used stolen identities, fabricated legal contracts, and encrypted apps like Telegram to execute their schemes. Unsuspecting targets were initially offered massive financial compensation to write seemingly benign research reports on sensitive global topics like U.S.-China relations and Middle East conflicts. Once the targets were financially hooked, the recruiters aggressively shifted tactics, pressuring the workers into violating their oaths by handing over exclusive, non-public information. The dangerous cycle of international money laundering, identity theft, and attempted bribery was halted today when federal authorities replaced the weaponized domains with red FBI warning banners. U.S. counterintelligence officials emphasized that this operation aligns with severe warnings from the global Five Eyes intelligence alliance regarding hostile foreign adversaries exploiting professional networking sites. New US strikes on southern Iran. The market's first question: "how much more oil goes offline?" Wrong question. Hormuz traffic is already down 90–95%. There's almost nothing left to lose. What the strikes actually change is the clock. 🔸What was hit? The targets weren't random missile launchers, radar, mine-laying boats, command nodes around Bandar Abbas and Qeshm Island. That's the exact infrastructure the IRGC uses to enforce the near-blockade of the strait. CENTCOM frames it as self defence after the Apache shoot down. 💡Degrading Iran's grip on Hormuz doesn't reopen Hormuz. It makes reopening HARDER. Every strike shrinks the political space for the confidence-building both sides need to restart 5–10M bpd of flows. Less control ≠ more oil 🛢️The inventory hole Meanwhile the math compounds: OECD stocks heading toward ~2.3B bbl — multi-decade lows. Shell's CEO puts the cumulative deficit at 1.0–1.2B barrels, a year+ to rebuild even if things improve tomorrow. Every week of escalation digs the hole deeper. So the curve tells the real story: front-month supported, backwardation steepening but the long end stays capped. Why? The market still believes in Fujairah 2027, Guyana, Brazil, US shale. The stress window is 2026–27 These strikes don't price barrels offline. They price TIME how long the world runs on draining inventories. Duration, not disruption, is the trade. Watch the calendar, not the headlines.

Germany's Cobra 600 is essentially a flying missile rail. It copies the Shahed-136's A2A concept already demonstrated in Ukraine. It is armed with a single IRIS-T missile and comes equipped with 2x JetCat P1000 PROs for propulsion. These put out 1100N max thrust each. Compare the P1000 to the SoluNox engines made in Pakistan, which range to about 800N per their official literature. Perhaps it was last year that I posted that these engines could enable maneuverable, nearly-attritable loyal wingmen. Now you see below what one of these might look like. Another point of consideration is engine price. Chinese engines generating 1100N of thrust are ~$10K when bought in quantities of one(!). This is an illustration of how competition has shifted from platforms to cost + production capabilities. A reasonable cost estimate of an equivalent Chinese or Iranian "flying missile rail" is perhaps $50K. Here is info on the JetCat: jetcat.de/en/productdetails/… 1/2

I do not feel comfortable to say a word in defense of Trump's actions, but he should not be blamed for killing NATO. He has buried it, but the alliance effectively died when Obama in 2014 and, especially, Biden in 2022 refused to unleash its power to stop naked Russian aggression against free Europe -- the only purpose this organization was formed for back in 1949. Miles Taylor (@MilesTaylorUSA) Donald Trump has effectively killed NATO, at least for now. He didn't have to tear up a treaty or fire a shot. Here's the proof: A new poll shows the number of Europeans who see America as an "ally" has plummeted 50% since Trump came back into office. NINE out of TEN of our closest friends no longer see us as a friend at all. Put another way, the world's most consequential alliance has been effectively cut in half in 18 months. Some folks might say this is a "mood" that will pass, but they're wrong. Alliances aren't built on paper. They're built on one belief, i.e. that when the worst comes, your friends will come for you. That same survey found majorities in every European country now doubt America would defend them if attacked. If you don't know anything about international relations, let me tell you: this is basically the heart of the NATO alliance. It's now got a stake in it. Article 5 is the promise our allies invoked to run to our side after 9/11. They officially no longer believe we'd return the favor. Trump may not grasp what that means. But trust me, Vladimir Putin does. Xi Jinping does. Russia and China see how weak Trump has made America and the West. Donald Trump is headed to France next week for a G7 summit... and I hope our allies read him the riot act. If they don't, they should be prepared to write NATO's eulogy. Conversei hoje com a presidenta do México, @Claudiashein. Revisamos os avanços registrados nos compromissos de cooperação e diálogo político assumidos por nossos governos nos últimos meses. Destacamos as produtivas tratativas relacionadas à agenda de cooperação energética, que abrange desde a colaboração em biocombustíveis até a eventual assinatura de um instrumento entre a Pemex e a Petrobras. Here’s the problem. The liberal political class wants us to treat atrocities like Belfast as single, random, isolated incidents. “Yes, it’s horrific, but don’t overreact,” they say. “Let the police do their job. Justice will be delivered. Let’s remain united,” and so on. But the public can see that such incidents *aren’t* random or isolated. They are, in fact, all the consequence of massive state failure in the area of asylum and immigration. All roads lead back there. That’s why people are angry.. They are sick of the platitudes that get trotted out after each fresh incident. They don’t want to hear them anymore. They know that the decisions of establishment politicians have brought us to this current pass, and they don’t trust those same politicians to fix things, especially when some of them refuse to even recognise that the public’s anger is justified. There has been a huge vibe shift in recent years. Imagine - God forbid - there were another 7/7. Does anyone think the public response would be anything like as restrained as it was then? We are in really dangerous territory. The public don’t want flowers and candles and “Don’t let them divide us.” They want someone who says, “I recognise that the state has failed abjectly. We have allowed far too many people to settle in the country without knowing who they truly are. It has disrupted your communities. Your anger is justified. And I will do everything in my power to put things right.” Any politician unwilling to articulate that message, fully and sincerely, is effectively sanctioning more years of growing social disharmony and discord. Things cannot heal until those in power recognise the extent of the problem and what it will take to fix it. And, on both counts, most of them don’t. That’s why the next few years are going to be very, very turbulent.

Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Історичний факт, що німецький Вермахт за неповні 47 місяців умудрився від Західного Бугу дійти до Москви та Сталінграду, а також повернутися в Берлін. Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. В цілому, якщо великих змін не буде, то для окупації всієї Донеччини кацапам треба буде не менше 3 років. І в чому тут козир — пишіть у коментарях до публікації. Video

NEW: malware developers added nuclear & biological weapons text to to their spyware. Goal? To trigger LLM safety refusals... so that their spyware wouldn't be analyzed by an AI security scanner. Cleanest practical example I can think of for why over-indexing on first order safety alignment is risky. When closed (and open) models ship with aggressive refusals, they will be sprinkled with second-order blindspots that attackers will discover...and exploit. We are only in the earliest days of attackers leveraging these features, and it wouldn't surprise me if users systems that need to handle complex cybersecurity issues demand that models be less safety-blunted. In the weeds: @SocketSecurity's post also shows why intention matters in how you design a malware analysis pipeline to avoid prompt manipulation. About 11 years ago, with our very talented Annapurna team and informed by the unusual scale and insight we had in operating the largest cloud infrastructure, we decided to design and build our own CPU chip. Meta just committed to tens of millions of Graviton cores for their agentic AI efforts. Uber and Snowflake are deploying Graviton as well. Today, we released Graviton5 into General Availability. The reason customers are so excited about Graviton is that it offers about 30-40% better price-performance than comparable instances. This is a big deal at any scale. But, when you layer on top of how much CPU customers normally use with the fact that AI’s growth is driving explosive CPU expansion given that post-training, reinforcement learning, and agentic actions use CPU, Graviton becomes even more compelling. Excited for how Graviton5 will help customers. aboutamazon.com/news/aws/aws…

Its efficient design meets the needs of agentic AI workloads that demand real-time reasoning, code generation, and complex, always-on processing. Concluding my visit to #Ireland, I had the opportunity to meet with several of @IFAD’s long-standing partners in Ireland and discuss how we can advance our shared work on food security, rural transformation and resilient food systems. In my meetings with @martinheydonfg, Minister for @agriculture_ie, Members of the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Foreign Affairs and Trade we discussed the importance of investing in rural markets, employment and resilience. I valued the opportunity to engage with Irish government partners. Their engagement matters. Food security is directly linked to climate, economic and conflict related shock. Investment in food security and rural transformation present an important opportunity for economic prosperity and stability. Ireland is an important and long-standing partner for IFAD. Its priorities are closely aligned with IFAD’s mandate and with the focus of #IFAD14. Out partnership shows what effective multilateral finance can do when it is focused, country-led and linked to clear results. IFAD’s work is practical. We invest in rural people so they can increase incomes, access markets, adapt to climate shocks and build stronger local economies. Between 2022 to 2024, IFAD-supported investments increased the incomes of 49 million rural people by an average of 34%. Market access and agricultural production also improved for tens of millions more. IFAD14 is about scaling what works. Connecting capital with results, strengthening rural economies and building resilience where food systems begin. @dfatirl @GovIE #FinancingTheFirstMile

Professional surfer Matt Wilkinson had a close encounter with a shark while surfing near Ballina, New South Wales, on Wednesday, October 7. A Surf Life Saving NSW drone alerted Wilkinson with a recorded message as the shark circled near him off Sharpes Beach. “I was surfing out the back at Sharpes Beach and just cruising on my own and I heard a splash and a noise and looked around and couldn’t see anything,” said Wilkinson. “Then the drone came down and told me that there was a dangerous shark in the area, return to the beach. “I got to the shore feeling a bit weird and the lifeguards showed me the footage and I realised how close it came without knowing it was there. It looks like it’s going for my leg and it’s changed its mind,” he added. The beach was closed after the incident. Drone operator Beau Monks said he’d just launched his seventh drone flight of the day when he spotted the shark near Wilkinson. “It sort of came out of nowhere, then went right up to Matt. It moved pretty fast. I was tracking it and notified the lifeguards and used the speaker on the drone to get everyone out of the water. Within 10 seconds it was at the surfer and five seconds later it was gone,” said Beau Monks. Surf Life Saving NSW operates drones at 34 beaches across New South Wales. Video

🌋 46 years ago today, Mount St. Helens forever changed the Pacific Northwest — and the science of volcano monitoring. After more than a century of quiet, earthquakes and rising magma signaled that pressure was building beneath the volcano in the spring of 1980. On the morning of May 18, the mountain’s north flank collapsed in a massive landslide, triggering a devastating lateral blast that flattened 230 square miles of forest. Ash rose high into the atmosphere and drifted across the U.S, while volcanic mudflows, known as lahars, surged through nearby valleys to the Columbia River. Fifty-seven people lost their lives, including USGS volcanologist David A. Johnston. When the eruption ended, Mount St. Helens stood nearly 1,300 feet shorter than before. The eruption transformed not only the landscape, but also how scientists monitor and prepare for volcanic hazards around the world. ➡️ Watch USGS scientists recount their experiences before, during, and after the eruption: ow.ly/bX0250Z0V4G 📸: Mount St. Helens erupting above a quiet rural landscape, with ash and steam billowing into the sky. Mount Adams can be seen in the background.

I’m honestly surprised this has not received more attention in Europe. The most vivid public example was around the EU’s northeastern flank, with Poland and the Baltic region among the most affected areas. To my knowledge, this may be the first publicly documented wartime case of a space-based EW capability being demonstrated or tested. Lukasz Olejnik (@lukOlejnik) GPS and GNSS interference over Europe is starting to look like something far more serious than local outages, random radio noise, or classic ground-based jamming. Part of it may be linked to active electromagnetic emissions from Russian satellites. If that assessment holds, this is no longer just a technical issue. It becomes a question of national security, infrastructure resilience, and policy toward systems that are critical in aviation, shipping, energy, telecommunications, military operations, and precise timing. Researchers analyzed data from ground-based GNSS stations and found short interference pulses appearing at the same time across a vast area, from Europe to Greenland and Canada. That scale does not fit a local source on the ground. It points to an object high above Earth, with the geometry needed to illuminate a large part of the continent. The signal appeared very close to GPS L1, the core GPS band used by millions of civilian receivers. Its peak was around 1577.5 MHz, while GPS L1 sits at 1575.42 MHz, with a bandwidth of roughly 5 MHz. The data also showed a second burst around 1558.5 MHz, in a band used by China’s BeiDou system. In practice, receivers saw simultaneous drops in signal quality across GPS, Galileo, and BeiDou, in some places by about 10 dB. The key attribution to Russian Cosmos 2546 satellite came from comparing the arrival time of the pulse at two stations. Researchers used that time difference to define a quasi-hyperboloid surface in space, meaning the surface on which the source of the emission had to be located. When they compared that surface with the orbits of suspect objects, the best match was Kosmos 2546, a Russian early-warning satellite in a Molniya orbit. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/lukOlejnik/status/2064223171008463041#m

New credentials attack on Google, it's a subtle one. The email actually comes from account.google.com. It informs you that your recovery contact (an email you don't recognize) is about to reset your password and prompts you to take action. There's a link that appears to point to accounts.google.com but uses the continue URL parameter to redirect you to sites.google.com, which hosts the attacker's site. If you scroll down, you can see the bottom of the email, which just shows that someone is asking to add you as their recovery contact. The entire first part of the email is a user-controlled field in Google's system that the attacker controlled to include the malicious link and text.

Traffic was held up in a North Carolina national park as adorable bear cubs were play-fighting in the road. The incredible moment in Pisgah National Forest was caught on camera by Madelyne Voreh. In the video, three cubs can be seen playfully wrestling and chasing each other with mama bear nearby. Drivers are patiently waiting in their cars to allow the family to enjoy their time. “It honestly felt like one of those once-in-a-lifetime wildlife encounters,” Voreh told Storyful. “Watching the cubs interact with each other while their mother kept an eye on them was incredibly special and is something I’ll remember for a very long time,” she said. She added: “My hope is that any coverage of the video also helps educate people about responsible wildlife viewing. These bears were observed from a safe and respectful distance, and everyone who stopped to watch remained in their vehicles and gave the animals plenty of space. “The Blue Ridge Parkway is the bears’ home, and moments like this are a great reminder to slow down, be patient, and respect wildlife when visiting the area.” Video

Bret Weinstein cuts straight to the chase: "We are going to have an endless battle in which those of us who see what we believe is clear evidence of some kind of election rigging or fraud are faced with indignation from a vast array of people portraying themselves as more rigorous and careful who say, 'Where is your evidence? Where exactly is your evidence that there was something wrong with this election?' And we are gonna be caught in the following predicament. No piece of evidence is sufficient to establish that case. And the sum total of all of the evidence contains true things and false things. So it is also no good. So the question is, can you logically deduce that something has gone wrong? I believe you can easily. Can you prove it? No. And not being able to prove it means that the election will proceed. It will be validated by all of the structures, including the courts. And that means that those who take on the power that derives from these elections will be the result of whatever process we just went through, whether it was an election that happened to be anomalous through organic means, or it was the result of some kind of fraud or election rigging. That is not an accident. That is not an accident. And the point that I wanna make primarily is the primary evidence against elections that look like this being organic is not actually in the trickle of evidence that we are actually able to see, the moment by moment vote count that does something strange during the night when some large tranche of ballots is suddenly counted or something like that. The evidence is in the structure of how the elections are actually carried out. These elections are designed to allow fraud that cannot be detected and will not be prosecuted. And that's really the thing that we must focus on." @BretWeinstein Video

1. An investigation by ThePrint revealed that 6 Pakistani Earth-observation satellites were launched in the past 16 months. These spy satellites are also positioned to provide Pakistan with continuous imagery of Indian territory. #CutTheClutter, with my colleague Soumya Pillai who broke the story, explains how Pakistan is reviving its space programme, its strategic importance & what it means for India as well as for ISRO. 2. Pakistan’s launch of these 6 satellites is unprecedented, given that for years it averaged 1 or 2 satellite launches annually. These were launched between January 2025 & June 2026, & all are placed in Sun-synchronous orbits that make them ideal for surveillance. This allows them to pass over the same locations at roughly the same time each time, which makes it easier to compare images & detect changes on the ground. 3. One of the most important satellites was the 4th one, launched in October 2025 — the HS1, Pakistan’s first hyperspectral satellite. This is significant to strategic affairs because it has very advanced imaging facilities. Anything camouflaged, like military assets or military movements along the border, can be caught by it. And, it is not sensitive to weather. The imagery produced can distinguish between different materials & spot structural changes on the ground. 4. In the latest satellite launch — PRSC-EO3 on April 25 — an alteration was made in the orbit. This optimises repeated observation of a narrower geography. In this case, all of Pakistan & the northern territory of India, especially focusing on J&K. What this means is the satellite can make multiple passes over that same region. For instance, if a usual satellite covers the area once in 15 days, this satellite provides the advantage of covering that area multiple times in a day. 5. Pakistan is not overtaking ISRO, which is light years ahead. But what’s important to note is that Pakistan understands the strategic importance of space as a frontier for its strategic advancement & they are trying to catch up. SUPARCO spent years overshadowed by India’s spectacular achievements. Now Islamabad appears determined to rebuild capability, using smaller satellites, foreign launch services & strong Chinese support. 6. New York has passed a new law, the first of its kind in the United States, requiring clear labels on news content made with AI The law, called the NY FAIR News Act, states that any news story, weather report, sports update, entertainment article, or similar content must display a prominent, easy-to-see notice if it was mostly created by AI. The rule applies across all formats, including newspapers, websites, TV, radio, podcasts, images, and videos. The notice must appear at the top so readers or viewers immediately know whether a human reporter wrote it or if AI did most of the work. The State Senate and Assembly approved the bill on June 8, 2026 and now awaits Governor Kathy Hochul’s signature. If signed, the law will take effect 60 days later The rule does not apply to content that includes enough human work to qualify for copyright protection. There are no fines for individuals only the state attorney general can enforce the law against companies that violate it.

آئی ٹی کے شعبے میں فراہم کی جانے والی تربیت بین الاقوامی مارکیٹ کے تقاضوں کے مطابق ہم آہنگ کیا جائے. بد قسمتی سے ملک کی اکثر جامعات میں آئی ٹی کے شعبے میں فراہم کی جانے والی تعلیم جدید عصری تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ نہیں ہے. وزیراعظم نے پاکستان بھر کی جامعات میں آئی ٹی کے شعبوں میں فراہم کی جانے والی تعلیم و تربیت کے تھرڈ پارٹی آڈٹ کرانے ہدایت کی. وزیراعظم کی نوجوانوں کو جدید تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ اور نئی ابھرتی ہوئی ٹیکنالوجیز جیسے اے آئی، ڈیٹا سائنس، روبوٹکس وغیرہ میں بہترین آئی ٹی تربیت فراہم کرنے کے لیے روڈ میپ جلد پیش کرنے کی بھی ہدایت. اجلاس کو پاکستانی جامعات سے آئی ٹی کے شعبے میں فارغ التحصیل طلباء کی صلاحیتوں کو جانچنے کے لیے ایچ ای سی کی جانب سے حال ہی میں منعقدہ ٹیسٹ کے نتائج کے حوالے سے آگاہ کیا گیا۔ بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا آئی ٹی کے طلباء کے لیے منعقدہ نیشنل سکلز کومپیٹینسی ٹیسٹ میں پورے मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांची संवेदनशीलता; अडचणीतील शेतकरी कुटुंबाला तातडीने बैल व नुकसान भरपाई मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी लातूर जिल्ह्यातील भूमिहीन शेतकरी काशिनाथ गायकवाड यांच्यावर ओढवलेली बिकट परिस्थिती समजताच त्यांना तातडीने मदत केली. वीज पडून बैल दगावल्याने पत्नीला जोखडाला जुंपण्याची वेळ आलेल्या या शेतकरी कुटुंबाला अवघ्या काही तासांत एक बैल आणि दगावलेल्या बैलाच्या नुकसानभरपाईची रक्कम मिळाली आहे. लातूर जिल्ह्यातील देवणी तालुक्यातील बोंबळी खुर्द येथील शेतकरी काशिनाथ गायकवाड यांच्याकडे असणाऱ्या बैलाचा शुक्रवारी (5 जून) झालेल्या वादळी पावसात वीज पडून मृत्यू झाला. त्यामुळे काशिनाथ यांना शेतीची कामे पूर्ण करण्यासाठी पत्नी हौसाबाई यांना जोखडाला जुंपावे लागले, हे वृत्त मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्यापर्यंत पोहोचले. यावर मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी लातूरचे जिल्हाधिकारी तसेच सर्व यंत्रणांना तत्काळ मदत करण्याचे निर्देश दिले. त्यानुसार तहसील कार्यालयासह, पशूसंवर्धन, कृषी आदी सर्व यंत्रणा श्री. गायकवाड यांच्यापर्यंत पोहचल्या. पशूसंवर्धन विभागाने प्रयत्नपूर्वक एक बैल उपलब्ध करून घेतला आणि तो जिल्हाधिकारी व संबंधित अधिकाऱ्यांच्या उपस्थितीत थेट गायकवाड कुटुंबियांकडे सुपूर्द केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या या संवेदनशील हाताळणीमुळे गायकवाड कुटुंबाला मोठा दिलासा मिळाला असून त्याबद्दल त्यांनी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांचे मनःपूर्वक आभार मानले. @Dev_Fadnavis #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis

Fukushima's reactors shut down exactly as designed. Texas's power infrastructure was largely intact. And yet both became catastrophic disasters. Why? Because the failures didn't come from where anyone was looking. A new paper by Mr Tariq Ahmad of the National Maritime Foundation argues that the most consequential disasters in complex systems — ports, power grids, nuclear plants — rarely emerge from direct destruction. They emerge from the quiet collapse of the functions and dependencies holding everything else together. The Indian disaster management planning paradigm needs to institutionalise a function-oriented approach based on systems thinking to achieve resilience of her critical systems and infrastructure. Like Cato the Elder, we should keep returning to the fundamental question: What is the United States' endgame in Iran? First, President Trump can choose to launch additional strikes against Iran. However, there is little reason to believe that such actions would compel Tehran to surrender or abandon what it considers its core red lines. Second, a return to military confrontation would likely further destabilize the global economy and push the prospect of a negotiated agreement farther away rather than bring it closer. Third, even if President Trump is considering renewed military action, it remains difficult to understand the strategic rationale given that the same administration has repeatedly expressed its desire to reach an agreement with Iran. It is possible that the threat of force is intended to increase pressure on Tehran and extract concessions, but there is little evidence that such pressure would alter Iran's fundamental positions. Tehran's red lines are unlikely to change. Fourth, any strike on Iranian infrastructure would almost certainly trigger a significant Iranian response. At the same time, if Washington issues threats that it ultimately does not carry out, it risks further undermining the credibility of its deterrence posture at a moment when Iran has already absorbed substantial setbacks. For that reason, the key question is not whether the United States should strike Iran or refrain from doing so. The real question is how Washington's current policy serves its broader strategic objective. 𝐅𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐡 𝐍𝐚𝐳 We are pleased to announce that Dr. Farah Naz has successfully defended her Ph.D. thesis titled "𝐑𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐏𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧: 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐄𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞." Dr. Farah Naz’s research provides a comprehensive assessment of rural transformation across Pakistan by developing a district-level 𝐑𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐱 (𝐑𝐓𝐃𝐈) and examining its spatial and temporal patterns. The study highlights how factors such as irrigation, agricultural credit, education, infrastructure, and climate conditions shape rural transformation and contribute to regional disparities and development outcomes. যথাযোগ্য মর্যাদায় আন্তর্জাতিক জাতিসংঘ শান্তিরক্ষী দিবস ২০২৬ উদযাপন ঢাকা, ১০ জুন ২০২৬ (বুধবার): আজ সকালে ঢাকা সেনানিবাসের সেনাকুঞ্জে যথাযোগ্য মর্যাদায় আন্তর্জাতিক জাতিসংঘ শান্তিরক্ষী দিবস ২০২৬ উদযাপন করা হয়। অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান, এমপি। প্রধান অতিথি তাঁর বক্তব্যে ভবিষ্যৎ শান্তিরক্ষা মিশনকে আরও আধুনিক, দূরদর্শী ও প্রযুক্তিনির্ভর করার ওপর গুরুত্বারোপ করেন। তিনি জাতিসংঘ শান্তিরক্ষা কার্যক্রমে বাংলাদেশ সশস্ত্র বাহিনী ও পুলিশের নারী সদস্যদের সাহসী ও পেশাদার অংশগ্রহণের প্রশংসা করেন এবং বিশ্বশান্তি প্রতিষ্ঠায় আত্মোৎসর্গকারী শান্তিরক্ষীদের প্রতি গভীর শ্রদ্ধা জানান। একই সঙ্গে তিনি মহান মুক্তিযুদ্ধে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর ঐতিহাসিক ভূমিকার কথা স্মরণ করেন। অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধানমন্ত্রী জাতিসংঘ শান্তিরক্ষা মিশনে কর্মরত অবস্থায় ২০২৫ সালে সুদানে শাহাদাতবরণকারী ছয়জন সেনাসদস্যের পরিবারের সদস্যদের সম্মাননা প্রদান করেন। এছাড়া, ওই হামলাসহ বিভিন্ন শান্তিরক্ষা মিশনে দায়িত্ব পালনকালে আহত সশস্ত্র বাহিনীর সদস্যদের হাতেও সম্মাননা তুলে দেন। পরবর্তীতে, তিনি বিভিন্ন দেশে নিয়োজিত বাংলাদেশি শান্তিরক্ষীদের সঙ্গে ভার্চুয়ালি যুক্ত হয়ে তাদের সাথে কুশল এবং মতবিনিময় করেন। উল্লেখ্য, অনুষ্ঠানে স্বাগত বক্তব্য প্রদান করেন বাংলাদেশে নিযুক্ত জাতিসংঘের আবাসিক সমন্বয়কারী। এ সময় সরকারের পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী, মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রীর প্রতিরক্ষা উপদেষ্টা, সশস্ত্র বাহিনীর প্রধানগণ, সশস্ত্র বাহিনী বিভাগের প্রিন্সিপাল স্টাফ অফিসার, পুলিশের মহাপরিদর্শক, ঊর্ধ্বতন সামরিক ও অসামরিক কর্মকর্তাবৃন্দ, বিভিন্ন দেশের কূটনীতিক ও প্রতিনিধিগণ, আমন্ত্রিত অতিথিবৃন্দ এবং গণমাধ্যম ব্যক্তিবর্গ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

राज्यसभा चुनाव के लिए नॉमिनेशन भरते समय सामने आया कि इंडिपेंडेंट कैंडिडेट और BJP समर्थित 'नाथवानी परिमल' का असली नाम परिमल नाथवानी है। इसके साथ ही परिमल नाथवानी ने कानून के तहत डिफेक्टिव चीजों को एफेडेविट में फाइल नहीं किया। ये सीधे तौर पर नियमों का उल्लंघन है। हर कैंडिडेट को अपने नामांकन पत्र के साथ 6 बिंदुओं पर एफिडेविट देना पड़ता है, जिसमें आपके, पत्नी या संयुक्त परिवार के नाम पर रजिस्टर्ड फर्म की जानकारी देनी पड़ती है। इसमें परिमल नाथवानी ने सारे कॉलम उड़ा दिए और सिर्फ अपने और अपनी पत्नी के बारे में जानकारी दी। जब तहकीकात की गई तो पता चला कि ये एफिडेविट गलत हैं, जिसके बाद हमने इस पर आपत्ति जताई। जब रिटर्निंग ऑफिसर ने परिमल नाथवानी को इस बारे में लेटर भेजकर जवाब मांगा, तो उन्होंने अपने जवाब में सारी गलतियों को सही कर एक नया फॉर्म सबमिट कर दिया। हमने इसका विरोध किया और कहा कि ये कानूनन सही नहीं है। स्क्रूटनी के समय किसी भी तरह का नया डॉक्यूमेंट नहीं लिया जा सकता। ये पूरी तरह से गैरकानूनी है। परिमल नाथवानी का नामांकन रद्द होना ही चाहिए। : @eminentlawfirm जी Video

I had so many DMs about this post. I've been dealing with a bunch of schmummy gunkins so I haven't had an opportunity to read it. Well, I finally read this post and the cited source. I had to pause almost immediately upon opening the cited link because I was blasted right in my eyes with SLOP. > Why This Matters Now > Why Connected TV (CTV) is the Ideal Proxy It is pure slop. The purist of slop. It is slopium. It is radioactive AI slop @radioactivered would collect and hide in her walls. Anyway, besides it being written by AI and being a giant stinky pile of slop shit, it is (probably) technically accurate, although to confirm their findings I would have to download the silly TV apps they listed and reverse engineer them myself to confirm their findings (I'm not going to do that) In summary, your TVs allow you to install super sketchy apps and all sorts of other dumb gunk. These free apps on your TV are being bundled with BrightData stuff, a well-known and relatively-disliked company in Israel. BrightData allows you to profit off your free app. The money comes from BrightData turning your application into a VPN node, basically letting random stuff use your internet. In other words, if you write some free junk application, and a bunch of people install it, you'll profit by letting BrightData connect to these peoples devices (from the junk application) and do stuff. BrightData has historically used this stuff to bypass VPN blockers because the device they're tunneling through is a legitimate home computer address. This is a (sort of?) common occurrence on the Android app store (and probably iOS app store too, actually) and isn't a shocking revelation in my opinion. Is this illegal? Technically no because somewhere in the fine print (that no one reads) you're agreeing to it. Is this incredibly unethical? Yes, it is insanely unethical and many companies and people hate BrightData International Cyber Digest (@IntCyberDigest) ❗️🚨 An Israeli company has backdoored hundreds of millions of households through countless Smart TV apps, and they're quietly turning Samsung and LG TVs into exit nodes for AI web-scraping. Your TV is relaying strangers' web traffic from your home IP, your bandwidth, your address attached to whatever those scraping jobs touch. Roku, Fire TV and Google TV banned the practice. Samsung and LG didn't. The culprit is Bright Data's proxy SDK, which rides inside Tizen and webOS apps, 200+ on webOS alone. Datacenter IPs get blocked, home IPs don't. Include Security reverse-engineered the SDK and found its relay protocol has no message signing, authentication, or device attestation. Their words: less secure than typical malware command-and-control. To make things worse, they found that in iOS the relay tunnel binds straight to the physical network interface, so it routes around any VPN the user is running. Bright Data's config also ships per-country tiers. Devices in Uzbekistan and Oman are cleared to relay down to 1% battery, with data caps up to 60x the worldwide default. Before the BaCkDoOrEd replies land: technically you agreed. In practice you were enrolled into a global proxy network you were never given the information to refuse. It was a pleasure to meet President Connolly during my visit to Dublin this week. I enjoyed very much our conversation on #Ireland’s priorities on food security, nutrition, and rural transformation. I hope the President will be able to visit soon some of our investments in a remote rural area in one of the least developed countries. Ireland is an important partner for @IFAD. Its priorities on sustainable food systems, climate adaptation, biodiversity, and support for women, youth and vulnerable groups are closely aligned with IFAD’s mandate and the focus of #IFAD14. Ireland’s own famine experience and experience of An Gorta Mór gives Ireland a strong voice in global development. Hunger is not only a failure of production. It can also be the result of structural and political failure, with consequences that include forced emigration, dispossession and the loss of livelihoods. This vision also aligns closely with IFAD’s role as an international financial institution focusing on investing before crises deepen, strengthening rural economies and helping countries build more resilient food systems. Ireland has been part of IFAD since the beginning, as a founding member. Its support helps IFAD finance large-scale, country-led investments that improve rural livelihoods, expand market access and build resilience for small-scale producers. Concessional finance translated into practical investment, stronger rural markets and better resilience where food systems begin. @PresidentIRL @dfatirl @GovIE #FinancingTheFirstMile

True Federalism Demands Shared Sacrifice — Not Just Development Cuts @81ShahbazRana Excellent analysis. The ongoing talks between the Federation and provinces to amicably resolve this issue are positive, but one critical issue needs to be raised strongly. Petroleum Levy is essentially a provincial subject under the constitution, yet the Federation continues to impose it, and the provinces have allowed this to go on. This has already given the Federation around Rs 1.5 trillion only in the current year, and it is likely to continue in future as well. This should also be treated as provincial contribution. The right and fair approach is for both Federal and Provincial governments to equally cut their non-development/current expenditure. #DidYouKnow Bhadradri Kothagudem district in Telangana has demonstrated how improved mobility can strengthen girls’ access to education in remote regions. Many girls in the district faced challenges in continuing secondary education due to long travel distances, socio-cultural barriers, and limited awareness within families. To address this, 200 bicycles were distributed to girl students from Classes VII–IX across 19 government schools. The initiative led to a significant improvement in attendance. The number of students with attendance between 66–80% increased from 37 to 108, while 31 students achieved 81–90% attendance. Notably, the number of students with attendance below 30% was reduced from 5 to zero. Academic outcomes also improved, with students in the low GPA category (3–5) declining from 93 to 19, and those scoring high GPAs (8–10) increasing from zero to 32. Beyond improved attendance and learning outcomes, the initiative strengthened confidence among girl students and reduced the risk of school dropouts, highlighting the impact of targeted interventions in enabling educational continuity for girls in remote regions. Such achievements have been documented on the NITI for States (NFS) Knowledge Portal — an initiative under the State Support Mission. We had a detailed representation before the Election Commission. We told them, and we demonstrated according to us, beyond doubt and beyond any matter of controversy, that the RO has passed a perverse order. The Election Commission's own law, the Representation of the People Act, has Section 33A, which says that disclosure is required only in those cases where the punishment is more than two years, and above all, only in those cases where charges have been framed. The process of framing charges is a judicial process. A judge frames charges. Now, as any kindergarten or first-year law student knows, the first step is a private complaint. That private complaint may be baseless and may have no legs to stand on. The second stage is the taking of cognizance by the magistrate, which is a judicial and independent process. Ms. Natarajan only received a notice to appear before the court and explain why cognizance should not be taken. That means the notice she received was before any cognizance was taken. Without cognizance, no criminal case exists in the eyes of the law. There is no criminal case merely because I allege something against somebody else without cognizance being taken. They have rejected Ms. Natarajan's nomination despite the non-existence of even cognizance, which means there was no criminal case that she could have disclosed. Whereas Section 33A, says that after cognizance is taken, there will be an investigation. After the investigation, there will be a charge sheet. The RO's order uses the word "sangyan." Sangyan means cognizance. There was no cognizance taken. Ultimately, we also pointed out to the Election Commission that it has a huge reservoir of power under Article 324. It is a constitutional power, an untrammable power and an inherent power. It is the power to do justice and the power to right wrongs. We hope and trust that the Election Commission will realize that this creates a very bad, distorted, non-level playing field. A non-level playing field strikes at the heart of democracy. A violation of that strikes further at the heart of the basic structure of the Constitution. Therefore, we have requested them for an immediate decision. We have come on the day of withdrawal. There is sufficient time. This is a completely egregious, blatant, patently unlawful order, without any basis in law, and it should be set aside immediately. That is our request. : @DrAMSinghvi ji Chairperson, AICC Law, RTI & HR Dept. Video

Once deaths outnumber births the low birthrate crisis is far advanced. That usually means the fertility rate has been below replacement continuously for many decades. Most of Europe and East Asia have already reached that stage and will begin to decline quickly now. Our World in Data (@OurWorldInData) Where are more people dying than being born? For most of human history, more people were born each year than died. Populations grew very slowly for most of this history, then rapidly in recent centuries, as child mortality plummeted and people lived longer. But this is changing. As the map shows, deaths now outnumber births in a growing number of countries across Europe and East Asia. The balance of births and deaths tells us about a country’s “natural population change” — whether it would grow or shrink without any international migration. Where deaths outnumber births, the population will shrink unless enough people move in from abroad to make up the gap. A Chinese tracking device was discovered in 🇬🇧 Prime Minister's official car. The bug is believed to have been found in a sealed part of the vehicle imported from China. Its discovery during a sweep first emerged in 2023, sparking fears that Beijing was aggressively spying on ministers in the then-Conservative government. Now it has been revealed that the device was in fact found in the Prime Minister's car the previous year. Charles Parton, of think-tank the Council on Geostrategy, told the Commons Business and Trade Committee: “The prime minister's car in 2022 was emanating data to China through the cellular module.” This device is thought to have allowed it to communicate to others over mobile networks. It is not clear which of the three Tory prime ministers that year — Boris Johnson, Liz Truss or Rishi Sunak — was being targeted. Questioned by MPs about this, Parton — who served as a diplomat for almost 40 years, including more than 20 in China, Hong Kong and Taiwan – added: “A very senior member of the government who certainly knows whose car it was told me.” The part of the car containing the geolocating device had been installed by the vehicle's manufacturer, reports at the time said. Parton's claim came during a discussion about cellular modules, which he warned are 'in everything' including planes, cars and even smart doorbells. “The Chinese aim to get a monopoly in the manufacture of cellular modules, and they're doing pretty well at that already,” he told MPs. “If the Chinese wish to shut off all your vehicles, because they've all got cellular modules, it wouldn't be difficult.” Security officials have since dismantled government vehicles used by ministers and diplomats while looking for tracking devices. Electronic vehicle parts are said to be embedded with SIM cards before being sent to manufacturers as sealed units, with these capable of sending data back to state-owned suppliers in China. It is understood the Prime Minister's car is run by the Metropolitan Police. dailymail.com/news/article-1…

Fukushima's reactors shut down exactly as designed. Texas's power infrastructure was largely intact. And yet both became catastrophic disasters. Why? Because the failures didn't come from where anyone was looking. A new paper by Mr Tariq Ahmad of the National Maritime Foundation argues that the most consequential disasters in complex systems — ports, power grids, nuclear plants — rarely emerge from direct destruction. They emerge from the quiet collapse of the functions and dependencies holding everything else together. The Indian disaster management planning paradigm needs to institutionalise a function-oriented approach based on systems thinking to achieve resilience of her critical systems and infrastructure. This is the last time I yap about my prescription medication addiction. I'm well aware my peers, colleagues, and cat picture collection experts are like, "what the fuck is this shit? where is the malware and cats?" Anyway, thank you everyone for the kind words and thank you to the people who went way out of their way to call me bad names (I'm impressed by your persistence and irrational anger toward someone you've never met). After reading everyone's comments, I have come the conclusion you're all indeed correct: my physician is a fucking doofus and cutting 25% on a Benzodiazepine after 15 years of usage is incredibly dangerous. I took the initiative to contact an outpatient drug rehab center that also does medication management. After I spoke with them I felt pretty good. This was the first time a healthcare worker didn't treat me like a junkie for speaking about medication I WAS GIVEN BY MY DOCTOR. I'll be meeting with them later to put together a safe and healthy strategy to taper my Klonopin dependency that doesn't kill me or fry my brain. They were super super nice, helpful, educated, ... it unironically made me feel ... safe? I don't know the word for it. But a healthcare worker giving a fuck about me made me feel good inside. Also, as far as people asking me about my withdrawals so far: no, it's not like a nicotine or cigarette withdrawal. I don't feel cravings. My body just randomly decided to start going schizo and screaming "SWEET BABY JESUS, HELP ME". I've experienced chest pains, muscle tension, insomnia, mild panic attacks, tingling in the legs, gastrointestinal issues, headaches, weird long ringing in my ears ... but those have all been short lived and nothing truly unbearable. I'll be on the computer, looking at malware, and suddenly my legs are like, "hello, we are covered in ants". I'm like, "no you're not?" and my legs are like, "o ok my bad big dawg" and it goes away 10 minutes later. It's stuff like that all throughout the day in short bursts. It sucks at night when I want to sleep. My biggest complaint is the insomnia. The insomnia is wicked bad and it sucks. I want to sleep, my body is begging for sleep, but my brain can't seem to shift gears into sleep mode. Thanks for coming to my TED Talk
